test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The surface area of a solid cube is 726 cm². It is melted and recast into a solid cylinder of radius 11 cm. What is the height (in cm) of the cylinder? (take pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The surface area of a solid cube is 726 cm2

The radius of the cylinder = 11 cm

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of cube = 6(side)²

Volume of cube = (side)³

**Calculation:**

6(side)² = 726

⇒ (Side)² = 726/6

⇒ (Side)2 = 121

⇒ Side = 11 cm

So, volume of the cube = (11)³ = 1331 cm³

Let the height of the cylinder be 'h' cm

According to the question,

π × 11² × h = 1331

⇒ (22)/(7) × 121× h = 1331

⇒ (22)/(7)h = 11

⇒ h = 11 × (7)/(22)

⇒ h = 3.5

**∴ The height (in cm) of the cylinder is 3.5.**
